alternative: signed n = -126 copies nothing; PopN 130 then also pops the 0xff marker and the result is not 8
note: 0x34: operand u8 n (unsigned) = 130 (byte 0x82). The top 130 slots (7, 128 nothings, 8) are copied in order: depth 1 + 130 + 130 = 261. PopN 130 (unsigned) removes the copies, leaving the original 8 on top -> 8.
